artifact.canonical_name: MemDelta: Controlled Baselines and Hidden Confounds in Agent Memory Evaluation

sources.title: Primary source 1: http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29914v1
sources.role: Primary source used for chronology and technical verification

claims.text: The authors show that uncontrolled model, embedding, and retrieval changes can confound comparisons between agent-memory systems.

limitations.text: The evidence is the authors' arXiv paper/model card and reported evaluations; results are not independently reproduced in this Evidence review.

targets.finding: MemDelta varies one component at a time on LongMemEval-S (500 questions, 50+ sessions, three model families), showing that model, embedding, and retrieval changes can reverse memory-system rankings.
